_scoring.method_note: Blind lists saved to /tmp/auditA_20261106/blind_part1.txt before stored records were opened. 2009-A11514 and 2013-S2320 blind passes used a modal-sentence scan rather than a full read, so their recall is an upper bound. Recall computed as (correct+wrong)/(correct+wrong+missed); every stored correct record the blind pass did not list (e.g. 2009-A10507-03/-06/-07/-08) is in both numerator and denominator.

_classes.name: line-break hyphen left in quote
_classes.rule: re.search(r'[a-z]- [a-z]{2,}', quote) and not prefix (non|self|pre|re|co|multi|anti|semi|post|mid)- ; over duties+powers all sessions

_classes.name: condition, consideration or approval clause stored as a duty
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and re.search(r'shall be taken into consideration|must approve|shall approve the release', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: 'shall be based on' entitlement computation stored as duty
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and re.search(r'\b(abatement|exemption|credit|benefit)s?\b[^.]{0,120}shall be based on', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: local government actor left Unspecified
_classes.rule: agency=='Unspecified' and re.search(r'local sponsor|\bcount(y|ies)\b|\bcit(y|ies)\b|\btowns?\b|\bvillages?\b|school district', actor_raw, re.I) (over-matches actor_raw mentioning a city incidentally)

_classes.name: sunset extension with chapter citation as actor_raw and agency Unspecified (watch, not scored wrong)
_classes.rule: agency=='Unspecified' and re.search(r'(chapter|section) [\w-]+ of (the laws|part|chapter)', actor_raw, re.I)

_classes.name: citation-only new matter with reprinted operative text stored as record
_classes.rule: needs a braced-span check against the packet (record's only braced overlap is a cross-reference or a single citation word such as {{article}}); regex proxy r'as provided in subdivision \w+ of section [\w -]+ of this chapter,? and shall include' finds 1

_classes.name: real government duty dropped by benefit_entitlement or designation_no_actor
_classes.rule: dropped rule in (benefit_entitlement, designation_no_actor) and re.search(r'(commissioner|department|director of|comptroller|informational leaflet|shall be reimbursed|shall be distributed)', quote, re.I)
db_examples: 2009-A10260 designation_no_actor 'For the purpose of providing construction related'
2009-A10847 designation_no_actor 'be transferred by the comptroller as expenditures'
2009-A11514 designation_no_actor 'in accordance with the service and usage formula'

_classes.name: parallel provisions collapsed (known class, recurrence)
_classes.rule: record quote (first 120 chars, braces stripped, whitespace normalised) occurs more than once in the packet LAW TEXT while only one record carries that quote; over-matches repeated boilerplate
